product.name: TAP Affiliate Starter Course
facts: TAP is an affiliate network with 240+ affiliates and 110+ offers.
The course is 5 short lessons that take you to your first live offer.
After the lessons you get a 1-on-1 with James, the founder of TAP, on Telegram.
You need no followers, no product of your own and no face on camera.
Affiliates post simple slideshows for apps, Telegram communities and brands, and earn a commission when someone joins, signs up or buys through their link.
The launch price is $5 for the first 100 members.

brief: A short, catchy, upbeat pop jingle about starting affiliate marketing with no followers, no product and no face, and a five dollar starter course. About 30 seconds.
